headline: Anthropic launches Claude Sonnet 5 as a cheaper way to run agents
snapshot: Anthropic's Claude Sonnet 5 brings stronger agentic capabilities, lower pricing, and improved safety, positioning the model as a cheaper alternative to Opus, GPT-5.5, and Gemini Pro. The story matters because AI is moving deeper into legal and regulatory territory, where product speed, data rights, safety obligations and public accountability can affect adoption.
